posts.title: Your NAS Isn’t Dying. It’s Just Busy.
posts.description: My NAS wasn’t loud because the drives were dying. It was loud because I turned it into a tiny cloud provider. Auditing unused containers, disabling unnecessary healthchecks, and trimming excessive logging dropped disk I/O from ~40MB/s to under 1MB/s. Just because you can, doesn’t mean you should.

posts.title: Repaste, Reboot, Reclaim: How Fresh Thermal Paste Brought My Workstation Back From Thermal Hell
posts.description: My workstation sounded like a jet engine- until a 10-minute maintenance job changed everything. HWiNFO exposed the truth hiding beneath years of 24/7 use. One small tweak, massive difference. If your laptop runs hot and loud, this might be the most underrated fix.

posts.title: The Glorious Art of Not Being Home: Remote PC Gaming in the Real World
posts.description: Gaming from a hotel room TV? Yep. RemoteFX failed me, but Sunshine + Moonlight turned my Samsung S22 into a full remote gaming rig. VPN home, set bitrate, launch Moonlight - and play almost anything, even on terrible WiFi. Remote gaming in 2025 just hits different.
